implementation_style: H5 structure-corresponding controllers over acoustic-composition space; frozen-reference realization in short commit steps; numpy only; gain is the sole actuator (eq. 1)

selection_policy.unit_reference: frozen; chosen among proposals by best-candidate J before freezing
selection_policy.rule: argmin of the joint objective; only improvements accepted

warnings: goal length 30.0s outside the expected 10-30s range
material 1 length 683.4s outside the expected 180-600s range
material 3 length 709.5s outside the expected 180-600s range
implementation_gaps: finite realization: reported scores are best-so-far over the finite set of legal trajectories examined
analysis holds each gain at its window-centre value inside a 46.4 ms window; proxy-vs-rendered composition distance is measured on the same windows and recorded (not a hard constraint)
SCORED_HOLD segments are accepted by the checker when motion.nonzero_scored_holds=true but never generated
motion limits and perceptual behaviour are uncalibrated on real materials (calibration_status=UNVERIFIED)
mode fits are structure-corresponding controllers with bounded iterations; no trained DDPM/VAE/LLM/GAN and no claim of convergence or distribution matching
the acoustic representation (energy, 8 bands, flux, contribution proxies, pair relations) is a reduction; different sounds can share a proxy score
local realization uses additive bump corrections on a legal base trajectory (one curve family, audit C6.1); the base reversal times are fixed at the warm start

analysis.window_gain_hold_note: gains held at window-centre value inside each 46.4 ms analysis window; mixture quadratic forms are exact for the summed PCM under that hold; windows never cross the end of the rendered piece

hold_mode.law: per hold the reference distribution is a set of EXACT plans that continue from the current positions / levels and are narrowed to a distance band around the committed history (the anchor = the mean of the last committed block); eq. (40) weights the kept plans; p_Theta(b, w) draws an origin class (slot) from a categorical carried across holds and units, one kept plan inside it with the eq. (40) weights, and a Gaussian displacement w of the MATERIAL LEVELS of the plan's steps (clipped into [0, 1]); the published ideal is the exact plan_rows of that displaced plan and the plan itself is in Target.meta['plan']
hold_mode.realizability: xi_hat[rows] = plan_rows(plan) of the engine's own evaluator; the xi-space displacement B_ref w of eq. (41) is NOT added in hold mode (it is not realizable) - it stays in the legacy path

slot_meaning.levels_only: level moves of the materials, no jump
slot_meaning.committed_positions: jump to a position of the committed history (events' src_position, positions the realizer committed earlier)
slot_meaning.fragment_candidates: jump to an.fragment_candidates for the band profile of the recent committed compositions

hold_mode.narrowing: keep the plans whose rows at the end of the hold lie in [0.0, 16.0] x (the hold's own flutter, measured on the UNCHANGED continuation) x (hold_move_scale x openness)^2 of the anchor: neither the unchanged sound nor an unrelated mix
hold_mode.discriminator: positives = the kept plans' exact rows on the committed rows with weights r_b; negative = the committed composition on the same rows; D step(s) then G step(s) once per committed block
hold_mode.generator_update: REINFORCE (eq. 45) on (slot, level displacement) with the same importance correction / ESS trust region as the legacy law

config_defaults_used.note: read from mode_defaults.gan with .get; not present in config.py DEFAULTS (shared file not edited), so a project file cannot set them until they are added there

approximations: E_hist of eq. (40) is evaluated on a full-unit trajectory whose rows outside the held window are the anchor, so within one hold it varies only through the window rows: r_b is dominated by E_form there

the per-hold restriction of p_Theta to the slots that survived the narrowing is treated as part of the environment, not of p_Theta (it cancels in the importance ratio only when the same slots survive)
candidate plans are screened on a row subset (flux is then computed between non-adjacent rows); the kept plans and the published plan are evaluated on all rows

reference_distribution.rule: eq. 40 over random FRAGMENT composition trajectories: a new random fragment composition (positions + material levels) every 2.0 s along the unit, exact mixture rows at hop-spaced offsets after the sampled positions (what sounds after a jump), goal level from the form's exposure policy per phase, GOAL_HOLD rows = xi_goal
reference_distribution.weights: r_b ∝ exp(-J_ref/tau_ref), J_ref = E_form + 0.2 E_hist on the reference trajectory (E_form from the sampled compositions' c / E)

config_defaults_used.note: read from mode_defaults.gan with .get; not present in config.py DEFAULTS (shared file not edited), so a project file cannot set them until they are added there

reference_distribution.statistic: D of the committed composition vs D of fresh random fragment compositions drawn at the same rows (per step, summarised per unit); the fresh draws come from a separate seeded stream (config seed + 977) so that the measurement never moves the job rng, are never used for a D or G update, and are not a goal test
reference_distribution.ideal_motion: mean per-step displacement of the frozen ideal, d_xi^2 (eq. 22) between rows 5 apart (0.5 s model step)

update_unit.when: once per committed block (engine commit step), never during realization
update_unit.order: D step(s) with backtracking, then G step(s) by REINFORCE
update_unit.positives: reference compositions restricted to the committed rows, weights r_b
update_unit.negative: the committed realized composition on the same rows
update_unit.short_block_rule: fewer than 3 free rows: accumulate blocks; if none are left at the unit end the reason is recorded
update_unit.baseline: EMA of past committed losses (rate 0.2); the first committed block uses its own loss
update_unit.C_fail: not exercised under the frozen-reference engine: every frozen reference is realized by the realization layer, so no proposal is unrealizable

unused_config.gan_adversarial_rounds_max: unused: the update unit is one committed block, not a search round (mode.update() is not called)
unused_config.C_fail: read but not applied; see above

basis_change_policy.rule: mu / log_sigma of the displacement coefficients are re-initialised whenever the basis hash changes; phi, logits, parent acoustics, parent ids and the common history are inherited (audit B7 / D4.1, option 1)

equations.40: r_b ∝ exp(-J_ref/tau_ref), J_ref = E_form + 0.2 E_hist (discriminator not used)
equations.41: Xi_hat = Xi_b^parent + B_ref w, p(b,w) = alpha_b N(w; mu_b, diag sigma_b^2)
equations.42: D_phi(Xi) = sigmoid(phi^T psi(Xi)) on free windows of realized compositions
equations.43: L_D = -sum_b r_b log D(Xi_b^ref) - log(1-D(Xi^actual)) + l2 ||phi||^2
equations.45: grad E l = E[(l - b_past) grad log p_Theta(b, w)]

gan.claims: bounded co-adaptive updates on committed realized compositions; no convergence, no equilibrium, no optimal GAN, no discriminator threshold used as a goal test; near-uniform parent weights are not treated as a defect
